items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: God bless you, amigo, for your friendship and your kindness during the Orleans State.

ctx.x: This is from the picky units the day he died, huh? July 7th, yeah. 1971. Yeah. You didn't say the one from the state's item. I don't... I don't know.
Paul Mabelson. Uh-huh. One of the swellest guys I know of.

God bless you, amigo, for your friendship and your kindness during the Orleans State. Two men in North Bay and I went out to California and stayed a couple of nights with when we played there. Now, these are some acts from the blue room that I worked with. The Skyliners. There's a guy.
